justification: Standard: flips a ledger row that gates claims from open to fixed. Not Minor: a wrong flip hides a live problem. Not Critical: no code or data changes; the row reads from a live probe that must read 0 for the flip to be true.

pre_impl.existing_data: On 2026-11-24 python scripts/dq_probe_live.py --id DQ-33 reads 0 after PR #1699 and the Waverley retag apply (11,350 rows rewritten, 2 values changed, 0 narrowed).
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The row read 498 on 2026-11-23 and I expected a Part to be set by hand; 460 were fixed by the page map and 38 by page ranges.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Same two files the ledger already uses; the tracker row and dq_checks.json must agree, and both now say fixed.
pre_impl.external_source_error: If the probe is not 0 the ledger check fails, so the flip cannot hide a regression.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: A claim passes while Waverley rules apply to every development type.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: DQ-33 reads above 0 or the tracker and dq_checks.json disagree.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Before the retag apply the probe read 38.
falsifiable_check.observed_green: After it the probe reads 0 and prints CLEAN.

functions.name: dq_probe_live DQ-33
functions.input: no input; a live count of served council rows whose development-type source is no_config
functions.output: a count and CLEAN or red
functions.if_none: a count of zero is clean, never an error

functions.name: dq_check ledger agreement
functions.output: pass when both agree on the status
functions.if_none: a missing ledger row fails the whole check

values.read_at: the stored control text and the best matching sentence
values.if_missing: scores 0 and the control stays held

queries.purpose: No new query; the existing DQ-33 probe counts served non-Parramatta council rows with no_config
queries.where_clause: is_current and v2_is_actionable, source_council not null and not parramatta, v2_dev_type_source no_config

break_it.scenario: A later republish leaves rows with no Part again.
break_it.what_happens: DQ-33 reads above 0 and the row would be false.
break_it.how: The ledger row keeps its live check, so it goes red again by itself.

break_it.scenario: The tracker table and dq_checks.json disagree.
break_it.what_happens: The ledger check fails and blocks the merge.
break_it.how: Both were edited together and dq_check.py compares them.

break_it.scenario: The probe counts only no_config and misses other undecided scopes.
break_it.what_happens: A council could still have undecided scope that this row does not count.
break_it.how: DQ-114 and DQ-115 count the other undecided sources and both read 0 on 2026-11-24.
